title: Sean McVay casts doubt on Puka Nacua’s Rams future after season-ending surgery

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay casts doubt on Puka Nacua’s Rams future after season-ending surgery
sources.description: Rams coach Sean McVay addresses Puka Nacua's uncertain future after season-ending knee surgery, refusing to guarantee the star receiver returns in 2027.
